review_scope: Static implementation review of the five new sources and fixed protocol, with necessary reads of the frozen original TRAIN/optimizer/checkpoint/bridge helpers. AST syntax parsing only, without importing or executing experiment modules. This permits the specified one-shot CPU admission; successful admission and a frozen READY remain necessary before any model activation.
checks: The initial dense FFN weights are replaced by frozen FP16 square-root SVD factors. No original FFN weight, dense compensation, or permanently retained training residual is added. Actual model count and 72 expected shapes are asserted.

Both flows bind the same untrained stage-0 complete checkpoint and compare its full parameter digest/layout. The Answer flow loads that checkpoint, not Spectral stage-19 weights, optimizer, bank or predictions; both reset training seed42 after native gates.

Only FP32 A/B temporary factors are optimized, initialized by local layer/stage RNG with A zero and B fixed uniform scale. HostAdamW, outer FP16 autocast, scale4, dropout.1, stage resets and the original frozen TRAIN AST retain the fixed 1213/19/87 recipe.
The small QR/core SVD represents [left,4A][right;B] without constructing a dense parent W. It uses master FP32 A/B, so it is not claimed lossless relative to rounded/autocast training forward.

Gate deletion costs are -g and retain the largest signed values with index tie-breaking. Full scalar costs are sealed and the independent verifier reconstructs top200 masks. Candidate evaluations physically slice all factors to 200 columns/rows before whole-decoder NLL; identical/empty cases explicitly fall back.

Current candidates are chosen from current-stage FIT by fixed hash/group rules. The historical bank is unchanged during scoring and is merged only after selection. Logical byte caps are checked before cloning; rejected QA are not replaced by alternatives. Bounded online group eviction makes no global historical minimum-hash promise.

The LRU/current/bank CPU tensor union is deduplicated by underlying storage and reported separately from logical metadata payloads and process memory. Consolidation records expose coverage, refusals, extra QA and selection activity.

The original stage updates produce durable per-step optimizer witness files, 87 raw gradient records, 19 first-gradient tensors and 19 validity records. Final factors are frozen and A/B/gates absent; the final saved graph clears new training banks and the public visual LRU.

Every new checkpoint is saved/hashed before its predecessor weight is removed. The final complete graph is reloaded and full parameter/layout digests are checked before DEV, with full parameter digest unchanged after DEV.

Only the two new DEV sets are rescored with all original references/IDs. One Answer-minus-Spectral paired analysis is generated once; the old wide-QV threshold is copied from its existing proof, without old F1 or pair reruns.

STARTED follows a fresh physical-GPU1 ownership/memory/utilization guard and precedes Torch/CUDA import. The per-flow monotonic timer covers model work; actual per-flow and aggregate elapsed limits are checked. Original resource rows and checkpoint metadata are SHA-sealed and independently checked, including worker PID, visible GPU1 and run_finished.

The dispatcher is single-stream, rejects repeat starts and stops both flows after any started failure. Restart=no, no boot enable, no baseline/other-user GPU signals or automatic full confirmation are introduced.

READY will bind all five sources, the original scientific dependencies, TRAIN/SPLIT/config/base hashes, processor/tokenizer small files, both reviews, intervention and the sole CPU admission evidence.
resolved_pre_READY_findings: Added actual deduplicated CPU storage union plus logical batch-shape/dtype metadata accounting.
Added monotonic elapsed budget evidence, resource/summary/checkpoint-metadata hashes and independent per-flow/aggregate validation.
Added full signed gate deletion-cost scalar persistence and independent mask ranking reconstruction.
Final checkpoint clears public visual cache as well as new training memory; pre-final training_after phase is explicitly distinguished from compact consolidation boundaries.
remaining_boundaries_not_blockers: The original 19-task FIT native-interface gates are explicitly additional all-task pre-training forwards/generations, not future-task optimization, statistics for compression, or selection data; do not call the entire process free of all future-task forward exposure.
Storage-union values are explicit snapshots of retained CPU tensors, not a complete CPU/RSS peak or Python overhead bound. Process resources and CUDA peak accounting are separate.
Passing tiny CPU admission will establish limited implementation admissibility, not actual-model quality, final-weight benefit, original novelty or stable gains.
The review is static. No end-to-end executability, runtime budget success, actual count, checkpoint reload or generation equality is claimed as observed.
